headline: Zamboanga School Shooting Probe Traces Firearm to Bureau of Customs Issue
seoTitle: Gun in Zamboanga School Shooting Traced to Customs | FMB News
seoDescription: The approved FMB News evening brief reports that investigators traced a firearm used in the Ateneo de Zamboanga shooting to a government-issued weapon associated with the Bureau of Customs.
deck: The firearm finding shifts attention to weapon custody and how a minor gained access to a government-issued gun.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The approved FMB News evening package reports that police and interior officials traced a firearm used in the Ateneo de Zamboanga shooting to a government-issued sidearm associated with the Bureau of Customs.
The package says investigators were still examining how the student suspect gained access to the weapon. FMB News does not present that chain of custody as established.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The shooting left the student victim and suspected student shooter dead and triggered scrutiny of school safety, firearm storage and child protection.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The provenance of the weapon raises questions about government firearm accountability and household safekeeping without establishing criminal liability by any particular person.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch the PNP, DILG and Bureau of Customs for chain-of-custody findings, administrative action and any policy changes on firearm storage.
